_meta.purpose: German property/hotel deal sources our online crawl CANNOT reach (anti-bot, login wall, CAPTCHA, or crawl policy) or has NOT yet probed. Surfaced in the coverage tracker so the map is honest that its supply is not exhaustive — these are the known blind spots.
_meta.note: CAPTCHAs are never solved and login/paywalled inventory is never scraped (policy). 'cannot_crawl' = structurally blocked; 'not_yet_probed' = reachable in principle, queued for a future pass.

cannot_crawl.name: ImmobilienScout24
cannot_crawl.why: Largest German property portal by far; aggressive anti-bot (DataDome) and login walls; excluded by our crawl policy. The single biggest blind spot.

cannot_crawl.name: Immowelt
cannot_crawl.why: Major portal; bot protection + login gating; policy-excluded.

cannot_crawl.name: Kleinanzeigen (ex eBay Kleinanzeigen)
cannot_crawl.why: Very large private-seller inventory (distressed/off-market angle), but anti-bot and seller contact gated behind login.

cannot_crawl.name: hospitalityInside
cannot_crawl.why: Subscription/paywall; hotel deal flow behind login.

not_yet_probed.name: ZVG-Portal (Zwangsversteigerungen)
not_yet_probed.why: Official per-Bundesland foreclosure listings — high value for distressed buildings that fit the acquisition thesis; structured but not yet crawled.

not_yet_probed.name: Gewerbeimmobilien24
not_yet_probed.why: Commercial portal; not yet probed for crawlability.
